blocks.text: PANGLAO, BOHOL, Philippines — A 36-year-old security guard was found dead inside a guardhouse at a construction site in Barangay Lourdes, Panglao, Bohol, on Tuesday morning, Nov. 3. The victim was identified as Eulalio Abandingo Jr., a resident of Barangay Looc, Panglao. Barangay Lourdes chairperson Eva Lorete received a call at around 7 a.m. informing her that a lifeless body had been discovered inside the guardhouse at a construction site in Purok 3. Initial police investigation showed that the victim figured in a road accident on Monday night but did not seek medical attention and proceeded to report for duty. READ: […]...
